   \Delta H_{\text{vaporization, CH}_4} = 8.2 \, \text{kJ/mol}
   \]

2. Calculate the enthalpy change for vaporizing two moles of liquid oxygen:
   \[
   \Delta H_{\text{vaporization, O}_2} = 2 \times 6.8 \, \text{kJ/mol} = 13.6 \, \text{kJ/mol}
   \]

3. The total enthalpy change for vaporizing the reactants is:
   \[
   \Delta H_{\text{total vaporization}} = 8.2 + 13.6 = 21.8 \, \text{kJ/mol}
   \]

4. Adjust the enthalpy change of combustion to account for the phase changes:
   \[
   \Delta H_{\text{reaction}} = \Delta H_{\text{combustion}} + \Delta H_{\text{total vaporization}} 
   \]
   \[
   \Delta H_{\text{reaction}} = -890.8 + 21.8 = -869.0 \, \text{kJ/mol}
   \]
